# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy" "example_zero_trust_cws_policy" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  entrypoint = "entrypoint"
  filter = "x"
  name = "x"
  rego_source = "x"
  description = "description"
  tags = {
    foo = "string"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)
- `entrypoint` (String) Non-function rule declared in rego_source. Evaluation uses data.<package_path>.<entrypoint>.
- `filter` (String) Filter expression that determines whether this policy applies. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
- `name` (String) Name of the policy
- `rego_source` (String) Inline Rego source with a package beginning with "policy." Maximum 16384 UTF-8 bytes.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional free-form description.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags to attach. Keys are limited to 256 UTF-8 bytes and values to 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Server-assigned UUID
- `package_path` (String) Dotted path derived from rego_source. Begins with policy. and is unique per account.
- `updated_at` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
$ terraform import cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy.example '<account_id>/<policy_id>'
```
